scalars.scalar_value: Prior surgical and clinical scheduling experience.

items.item_text: Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Six (6) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus two (2) years of related experience/training.
Prior surgical and clinical scheduling experience.

The Administrative, Clinical, and Surgical Care Coordinator is a high level position providing executive support including Administrative, Academic, Projects, Clinical, and Surgical Care Coordination. This position supports will support Thoracic Surgical Oncology Faculty members of Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery Division within the Cardiovascular Institute (CVI).

Involves managing or performing the administrative services or managing the full general operations of an academic or non-academic organization(s). Administrative services include activities in finance and human resources and may also include IT, facilities, or student services. General management activities include long and short range strategic planning in determining the mission and directing all activities of multi-disciplinary departments through subordinate management staff.
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Knowledge of UCSD Systems including, Concur, Oracle, UC Path, ARC, UC Health HR, Ecotime, UC Service Now, Cisco, Epic, BLINK.
Solid communication and interpersonal skills to communicate effectively with all levels of staff verbally and in writing.
Knowledge of UCSD policies and procedures, including the willingness to understand and enforce these policies when required.
Solid organizational skills and ability to multi-task with demanding timeframes.
Knowledge with intermediate skills level working with Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Adobe-PDF, etc.
Working knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Ability to use discretion and maintain confidentiality.
